params.body:
**Triage proposal** (from the forwarded mail; change the labels if it is wrong)
Category: request  Priority: P2
Summary: A garage received leads that look like spam. The website widget's "Stel een vraag" form (`POST website/contact`) has no spam protection at all, so any script can open leads and mail the garage.

## What is wrong

`website/contact` is exempt from the request-forgery check (the iframe cannot rely on our session cookie), and it has no other guard:

- no honeypot, no render-time check, no limit on links;
- no throttle;
- no maximum length on name, phone or message;
- the `vehicle_id` is not checked against the dealer: any vehicle id opens a lead for the dealer of the hash.

A dealer hash is on every page that embeds the widget, so one POST per lead is enough.

## Proposal

The same traps the StockCars site uses on its own forms: a hidden honeypot, an encrypted render moment in the form (4 seconds to 24 hours old), at most 2 links in the message and none in the name. A refused post gets the same answer as a sent one and opens nothing. Plus a per-visitor throttle, the length limits of the public API's lead endpoint, and the vehicle rule of that endpoint (own car or a car the dealer's site lists).

The public API's door is covered on the site's side in stocklistdealer-eu/stockcars-website#37.

Source: Portal mail:10.
params.title: Keep spam out of the website widget's question form
